schema: §2.7 (v0.50) -- complete per-sentence segment disposition, superseding §21 R6's not_annotatable-only shape. `not_annotatable` (R6's original array, the only key run_scoring.load_not_annotatable() reads) is preserved for scoring and holds every NOT_OBLIGATION_BEARING / NOT_ANNOTATABLE / EXCLUDED span. `dispositions` is the full per-sentence record §2.7 requires, covering ANNOTATED and AMBIGUOUS spans too, which `not_annotatable` deliberately excludes -- an AMBIGUOUS span is an open reviewer question, not a settled non-item, and including it in the scoring array would resolve it silently.

reconciliation.note: All sentences accounted for; obligation-bearing clause count matches items_annotated exactly.

dispositions.rule: §2.6 (§2's ‘no obligation-bearing sentences’ exclusion row, applied at sentence granularity)
dispositions.reason: A numbered/lettered section or clause heading: no subject, no modal, no clause content of any kind -- one of the 13 spans §2.7 bulk-dispositions as a single class.

dispositions.span_text: NICE may, at its discretion, reschedule delivery of units of Products for which a PO has already been issued, by shortening the Due Date, without any implication.
dispositions.reason: 'NICE may, at its discretion, reschedule delivery ... without any implication' -- briefly drafted and locked as C14-03, then RETRACTED at batch verification: restricted scope ('already-issued POs only') is not monitorable stakes, and 'without any implication' is at least as direct a no-stakes signal as C11-046's 'sole business judgment'. Reviewer-tested and held (see §2.5.1's own negative worked example and C14-04's annotator_notes); no correlative party is named in this span. Never logged in exclusions.json until this retrofit added it as C14-044#S1 -- a small instance of the same un-logged-sub-sentence gap §2.7 exists to close, distinct from the substantive disposition itself, which is settled.

dispositions.span_text: In this respect, Contractor is aware that by the last three weeks of every calendar Quarter, a high level of flexibility is required to meet NICE' end of Quarter requirements.
dispositions.reason: 'Contractor is aware that ... a high level of flexibility is required to meet NICE’ end of Quarter requirements' -- an awareness/context statement, no modal verb, no party undertaking to perform an action. Same shape as C04-117's 'acknowledges' clause in this same batch.

dispositions.span_text: Contractor will perform its best reasonable commercial efforts to complete such rescheduled Products at the new requested Due Date.
All such rescheduling shall be performed by sending Contractor a written request for rescheduling.
